title: Kordell Stewart would like to join the Colorado coaching staff

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kordell Stewart would like to join the Colorado coaching staff
sources.description: Former Colorado quarterback Kordell Stewart, who spent 11 years in the NFL after a 1994 Hail Mary to beat Michigan became one of the great plays in college football history, would like to return to Boulder as a member of Deion Sanders's coaching staff.
